02_decoupler/01_数据准备与网络加载.r r · 2690 bytes 
# ==============================================================================
# decoupleR 实战 01：数据准备与调控网络加载
# 来源：KS 教程《Nature | 从 Bulk 数据中推断转录因子活性（decoupleR 实战）》
# 输入：bk_data.rds（含 counts / design / limma_ttop 三要素）
# 输出：decoupleR_input.rds（供 02-04 脚本直接读取）
# ==============================================================================

library(decoupleR)   # TF 活性推断核心包
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)

# ---- 1. 读取教程示例数据 ------------------------------------------------------
# bk_data.rds 是一个 list，包含三样核心输入：
#   $counts     基因 x 样本 表达矩阵（带 gene 列）
#   $design     分组信息（样本 x 条件）
#   $limma_ttop limma 差异分析结果（WT vs KO，含 logFC / t / P.Value）
# ⚠️ 大数据不入库：请从本机原始目录提供该文件，或换成自己的数据
data <- readRDS("bk_data.rds")

# ---- 2. 表达矩阵 counts -------------------------------------------------------
# 行 = 基因，列 = 样本；缺失值填 0（decoupleR 不接受 NA）
counts <- data$counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(~ any(is.na(.x)),
                   ~ dplyr::if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

head(counts)

# ---- 3. 分组信息 design -------------------------------------------------------
design <- data$design
head(design)

# ---- 4. 差异分析统计量 deg ----------------------------------------------------
# 重点保留 t 值：t = logFC / SE，同时携带方向和显著性，
# 是 decoupleR 推荐的对比水平活性推断输入（limma 的 t 或 DESeq2 的 stat 均可）
deg <- data$limma_ttop %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, logFC, t, P.Value) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(t)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

head(deg)

# ---- 5. 加载 CollecTRI 转录因子-靶基因调控网络 --------------------------------
# CollecTRI 整合 12 个数据库的 TF-target 调控关系，比 DoRothEA 覆盖更全、性能更好
# split_complexes = FALSE：蛋白复合物形式的 TF 不拆分成亚基单独计分
# 物种换小鼠时：get_collectri(organism = 'mouse', split_complexes = FALSE)
net <- decoupleR::get_collectri(organism = 'human',
                                split_complexes = FALSE)

head(net)
dim(net)

# ---- 6. 保存中间对象（供后续脚本直接读取） ------------------------------------
saveRDS(list(counts = counts, design = design, deg = deg, net = net),
        "decoupleR_input.rds")
02_decoupler/02_样本水平tf活性_ulm.r r · 2825 bytes 
# ==============================================================================
# decoupleR 实战 02：样本水平 TF 活性推断（ULM）+ top25 热图
# 原理：对每个样本 x 每个 TF，以靶基因的 mor 权重作预测变量、
#       该样本中靶基因的表达值作响应变量拟合线性模型，斜率的 t 值 = TF 活性得分
# 输入：decoupleR_input.rds（01 脚本产出）
# 输出：TF活性热图_top25.pdf（矢量 PDF）
# ==============================================================================

library(decoupleR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

input  <- readRDS("decoupleR_input.rds")
counts <- input$counts
net    <- input$net

# ---- 1. ULM 活性推断 ----------------------------------------------------------
# minsize = 5：至少 5 个靶基因的 TF 才参与推断，过滤低支持度 TF
sample_acts <- decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = counts,
                                  net = net,
                                  .source = 'source',
                                  .target = 'target',
                                  .mor = 'mor',
                                  minsize = 5)

head(sample_acts)

# ---- 2. 长表转宽矩阵：行 = 样本(condition)，列 = TF ---------------------------
n_tfs <- 25

sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'condition',
                     names_from = 'source',
                     values_from = 'score') %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames('condition') %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- 3. 取跨样本变异最大的前 25 个 TF -----------------------------------------
tfs <- sample_acts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(std = stats::sd(score)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(-abs(std)) %>%
  head(n_tfs) %>%
  dplyr::pull(source)

sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts_mat[, tfs]

# ---- 4. 按 TF（列）做 z-score 标准化，便于跨 TF 比较相对活性高低 --------------
sample_acts_mat <- scale(sample_acts_mat)

# ---- 5. 配色与断点：RdBu 反转，红 = 高活性，蓝 = 低活性 -----------------------
colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(colors = colors)(100)

my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0, length.out = ceiling(100 / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out = floor(100 / 2)))

# ---- 6. 热图（filename 直接落盘为矢量 PDF） ------------------------------------
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = sample_acts_mat,
                   color = colors.use,
                   border_color = "white",
                   breaks = my_breaks,
                   cellwidth = 15,
                   cellheight = 15,
                   treeheight_row = 20,
                   treeheight_col = 20,
                   filename = "TF活性热图_top25.pdf")
02_decoupler/03_差异水平tf活性_ulm.r r · 3501 bytes 
# ==============================================================================
# decoupleR 实战 03：差异水平 TF 活性推断（WT vs KO 对比）+ 条形图
# 输入：差异分析 t 值矩阵 deg[, 't']——代表 WT vs KO 的整体变化方向与显著性
# 输出：TF活性差异_barplot.pdf（矢量 PDF）
# ==============================================================================

library(decoupleR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

input <- readRDS("decoupleR_input.rds")
deg   <- input$deg
net   <- input$net

n_tfs <- 25

# ---- 1. 用 t 值做 ULM：得到每个 TF 在"对比"水平的活性得分 ---------------------
contrast_acts <- decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = deg[, 't', drop = FALSE],
                                    net = net,
                                    .source = 'source',
                                    .target = 'target',
                                    .mor = 'mor',
                                    minsize = 5)

# ---- 2. 排名：正分按得分降序排，负分按绝对值降序排 ----------------------------
# 目的：让"最激活"和"最抑制"的 TF 都排到前面，一起进入 top n
f_contrast_acts <- contrast_acts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rnk = NA)

msk <- f_contrast_acts$score > 0

f_contrast_acts[msk, 'rnk']   <- rank(-f_contrast_acts[msk, 'score'])
f_contrast_acts[!msk, 'rnk']  <- rank(-abs(f_contrast_acts[!msk, 'score']))

# ---- 3. 取排名靠前的 n_tfs 个 TF ----------------------------------------------
tfs <- f_contrast_acts %>%
  dplyr::arrange(rnk) %>%
  head(n_tfs) %>%
  dplyr::pull(source)

f_contrast_acts <- f_contrast_acts %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% tfs)

# ---- 4. 配色：蓝 = 活性下降，红 = 活性上升 ------------------------------------
colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

# ---- 5. 条形图 -----------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = f_contrast_acts,
                     mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = stats::reorder(source, score),
                                            y = score)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(mapping = ggplot2::aes(fill = score),
                    color = "black",
                    stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = colors[1],
                                mid = "whitesmoke",
                                high = colors[2],
                                midpoint = 0) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                 axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45,
                                                     hjust = 1,
                                                     size = 10,
                                                     face = "bold"),
                 axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10,
                                                     face = "bold"),
                 panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                 panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  ggplot2::xlab("TFs")

p

# ---- 6. 输出矢量 PDF -----------------------------------------------------------
ggplot2::ggsave("TF活性差异_barplot.pdf", p,
                width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")

# ---- 7. 教程示例结果解读 -------------------------------------------------------
# GLI3、SPDEF：KO 中活性下降（可能受 FOXA2 正调控）
# MUC、NFKB1 ：KO 中活性上升（可能被 FOXA2 抑制）
02_decoupler/04_tf靶基因火山图.r r · 3072 bytes 
# ==============================================================================
# decoupleR 实战 04：深入解析单个 TF 的靶基因变化（以 SP1 为例）
# 逻辑：把 CollecTRI 中该 TF 的靶基因（带 mor 调控符号）映射到差异分析结果上，
#       mor 与 t 同号（一致激活/抑制）标红，异号（矛盾）标蓝，其余灰色
# 输入：decoupleR_input.rds
# 输出：TF靶基因火山图_SP1.pdf（矢量 PDF）
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)

input <- readRDS("decoupleR_input.rds")
deg   <- input$deg
net   <- input$net

tf <- 'SP1'   # 换成任意感兴趣的 TF

# ---- 1. 取该 TF 的靶基因，并准备画图框 ----------------------------------------
df <- net %>%
  dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(target) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID = target, color = "3") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames('target')

# ---- 2. 只保留差异分析结果里也有的靶基因 --------------------------------------
inter <- sort(dplyr::intersect(rownames(deg), rownames(df)))

df <- df[inter, ]

df[, c('logfc', 't_value', 'p_value')] <- deg[inter, ]

# ---- 3. 着色逻辑 ---------------------------------------------------------------
# color = 1（红）：mor 与 t 同号 → 靶基因变化支持 TF 活性方向（一致激活/一致抑制）
# color = 2（蓝）：mor 与 t 异号 → 与 CollecTRI 调控方向矛盾
# color = 3（灰）：mor 或 t 缺失 / 为 0
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor > 0 & t_value > 0, '1', color)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor > 0 & t_value < 0, '2', color)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor < 0 & t_value > 0, '2', color)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor < 0 & t_value < 0, '1', color))

colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

# ---- 4. 火山图：点大小 = |mor|（调控权重强度） ---------------------------------
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = df,
                     mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = logfc,
                                            y = -log10(p_value),
                                            color = color,
                                            size = abs(mor))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5,
                      color = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[1], "grey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(mapping = ggplot2::aes(label = ID,
                                                   size = 1)) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dotted') +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dotted') +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(tf)

p

# ---- 5. 输出矢量 PDF -----------------------------------------------------------
ggplot2::ggsave("TF靶基因火山图_SP1.pdf", p,
                width = 8, height = 6, device = "pdf")
03_rcistarget/01_rcistarget_hypoxia示例.r r · 9965 bytes 
# ============================================================
# RcisTarget：从基因集反推上游核心转录因子（motif 富集）
#
# 来源: 微信公众号《只会做差异分析不够：Cell Stem Cell用RcisTarget找到核心转录因子才能讲清机制》
# 原文: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/N9sndyeJgk7JvvSvEVAeGw
# 案例文献: Taubenschmid-Stowers et al. 2022, Cell Stem Cell
#           "8C-like cells capture the human zygotic genome activation
#            program in pluripotent stem cells"（Fig.3 用 RcisTarget 找到 DUX4/DUXA/KLF17）
# 蒸馏整理: hz-bioinfo-codes / 01_单细胞 / 1.7_转录因子分析 / 03_RcisTarget
#
# 核心逻辑:
#   基因集 → 在 motif ranking 数据库中看这些基因是否整体扎堆靠前
#   → AUC（富集程度）→ NES（标准化，>3 显著）→ motif→TF 注释
#   → 显著靶基因 → TF(motif)-gene 网络
#
# 标注约定:
#   ✅ 原文代码原样保留
#   🔶 [重构] 原文代码碎片化/伪代码，按官方 vignette 逻辑补全
#   ⚠️ [未验证] 原文函数在标准包中不存在或存疑
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. 环境准备 ✅
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE = "en")
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
library(RcisTarget)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 安装 motif 数据库（手动下载 tar.gz 后本地安装）✅
#    本脚本用的是 demo 库: hg19 + cisbp-only + TSS 上游 500bp
#    ⚠️ 复现 Cell Stem Cell 论文（TSS ± 10kb）需换用完整版
#       hg19/hg38 rankings 数据库（见 README「注意事项」）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 手动下载 RcisTarget.hg19.motifDBs.cisbpOnly.500bp（Bioconductor 页面提供 tar.gz）
pkg_targz <- "D:/Edge浏览器下载/RcisTarget.hg19.motifDBs.cisbpOnly.500bp_1.30.0.tar.gz"
if (!requireNamespace("RcisTarget.hg19.motifDBs.cisbpOnly.500bp", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!file.exists(pkg_targz)) {
    stop("找不到本地 tar.gz：", pkg_targz,
         "\n请把 pkg_targz 改成你实际文件路径（用 /）")
  }
  install.packages(pkg_targz, repos = NULL, type = "source")
}
library(RcisTarget.hg19.motifDBs.cisbpOnly.500bp)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 准备基因集 ✅
#    输入: GeneSet.txt（每行一个基因 symbol，此处为缺氧相关基因）
#    输出: geneLists —— named list，后续所有分析围绕它
#    💡 换成自己的场景: DEG 上调基因 / cluster marker / WGCNA 模块 / 通路基因集
# ------------------------------------------------------------
geneList1 <- read.table("GeneSet.txt")[,1]
geneLists <- list(hypoxia = geneList1)
geneLists

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 加载 ranking + motif 注释（RcisTarget 两大核心资源）✅
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# motifRankings: 每个 motif 对全基因组的排序列表
#   排序依据 = 该 motif 在每个基因附近（此处 TSS 上游 500bp）的匹配强度
#   直观理解: 对每个 motif，都有一张"最可能被它调控的基因"排名表
data(hg19_500bpUpstream_motifRanking_cispbOnly)   # 注意对象名拼写是 cispb（官方如此）
motifRankings <- hg19_500bpUpstream_motifRanking_cispbOnly

# motifAnnotations: motif ID → 候选 TF（区分高置信/低置信）
data(hg19_motifAnnotation_cisbpOnly)
motifAnnotations <- hg19_motifAnnotation_cisbpOnly

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 一步法：cisTarget() ✅
#    把 "AUC → NES → 注释 → 显著基因" 打包成一步跑完
#    输出: motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes，每行一个 motif，
#          含 AUC/NES、注释 TF、预测显著基因列表
# ------------------------------------------------------------
motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes <- cisTarget(geneLists,
                                         motifRankings,
                                         motifAnnot = motifAnnotations)
motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. 分步法（与第 4 步等价，便于检查中间结果）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.1 计算 AUC ✅
#     对每个 motif，计算基因集在该 motif 排名列表前端的富集程度
motifs_AUC <- calcAUC(geneLists, motifRankings, nCores = 1)
motifs_AUC

# 5.2 AUC → NES + motif 注释 + 过滤 ✅
#     nesThreshold=3: 只保留 NES ≥ 3 的显著 motif
#     highlightTFs:   高亮你关心的 TF（此处缺氧案例关注 HIF1A/EPAS1）
motifEnrichmentTable <- addMotifAnnotation(
  motifs_AUC, nesThreshold = 3, motifAnnot = motifAnnotations,
  highlightTFs = list(hypoxia = c("HIF1A", "EPAS1"))
)
motifEnrichmentTable   # 此时还没有显著基因列表

# 5.3 给每个显著 motif 找"显著基因" 🔶 [重构]（原文为 ... 省略写法）
#     在 motif 的基因 ranking 中找领先富集的一段基因 = 候选靶基因
#     method="aprox": 近似算法，速度快、离线友好（精确法为 "iCisTarget"，更慢）
motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes2 <- addSignificantGenes(
  resultsTable = motifEnrichmentTable,
  geneSets     = geneLists,
  rankings     = motifRankings,
  maxRank      = 500,
  method       = "aprox"
)
motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes2

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. AUC 直方图（诊断图）✅
#    所有 motif 的 AUC 分布；红线 = 由 NES=3 反推的 AUC 阈值位置，
#    红线右侧的 motif 更可能是关键调控 motif
# ------------------------------------------------------------
auc <- getAUC(motifs_AUC)["hypoxia", ]
hist(auc,
     main = "hypoxia",
     xlab = "AUC histogram",
     breaks = 100,
     col = "#ff000050",
     border = "darkred")
nes3 <- (3 * sd(auc)) + mean(auc)
abline(v = nes3, col = "red")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Recovery curve（基因恢复曲线）🔶 [重构]（原文为 ... 省略写法）
#    横轴: 在 motif ranking 里往后扫到第几名（maxRank）
#    曲线越靠前、上升越快 → 基因集越集中在 ranking 顶部 → motif 越相关
# ------------------------------------------------------------
selectedMotifs <- sample(motifEnrichmentTable$motif, 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
getSignificantGenes(geneSets         = geneLists$hypoxia,
                    rankings         = motifRankings,
                    signifMotifNames = selectedMotifs,
                    maxRank          = 5000,
                    plotCurve        = TRUE,
                    method           = "aprox")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Motif logo（展示前 10 个显著 motif）⚠️ [未验证]
#    原文调用 showLogo(resultsSubset)，但 RcisTarget 主包未导出该函数，
#    可能是作者自定义辅助函数或笔误。
#    官方替代: ① DT::datatable 交互查看结果表（下方注释）
#              ② 用 motifStack/ universalmotif 依据 motif PWM 画 logo
#              ③ cisTarget 网页工具在线查看
# ------------------------------------------------------------
resultsSubset <- motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes[1:10, ]
# showLogo(resultsSubset)   # ⚠️ 原文写法，标准包中不存在

# 官方 vignette 的查看方式（交互表格）:
# library(DT)
# datatable(as.data.frame(resultsSubset[, -which(names(resultsSubset) %in%
#          c("enrichedGenes", "TF_lowConf", "TF_highConf"))]))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. 提取高置信 TF 列表 🔶 [重构]（原文为伪代码 lapply(split(...), ...)）
#    TF_highConf 列内是分号分隔的 TF 串，按基因集拆开并去重
# ------------------------------------------------------------
tfCol <- "TF_highConf"   # 可换 "TF_lowConf" 看低置信注释
annotatedTFs <- lapply(
  split(motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes[[tfCol]],
        motifEnrichmentTable_wGenes$geneSet),
  function(x) unique(unlist(strsplit(x, "; ")))
)
annotatedTFs$hypoxia   # 该基因集对应的高置信 TF 向量

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. TF(motif)-gene 交互网络（visNetwork）🔶 [重构]（原文给的是流程骨架）
#     菱形节点 = motif，椭圆节点 = gene，
#     边 = 该 motif 预测调控该 gene（在 ranking 前端显著）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(reshape2)
library(visNetwork)

# 10.1 选前 3 个显著 motif，取 motif × gene 的 0/1 关联矩阵
signifMotifNames <- motifEnrichmentTable$motif[1:3]
incidenceMatrix <- getSignificantGenes(
  geneSets         = geneLists$hypoxia,
  rankings         = motifRankings,
  signifMotifNames = signifMotifNames,
  maxRank          = 5000,
  genesFormat      = "incidMatrix",
  method           = "aprox"
)$incidMatrix

# 10.2 关联矩阵 → 长表 edges（from=motif, to=gene）
edges <- melt(incidenceMatrix)
edges <- edges[edges$value > 0, ]
colnames(edges) <- c("from", "to", "value")

# 10.3 构建节点并画交互网络
motifNodes <- data.frame(id    = signifMotifNames,
                         label = signifMotifNames,
                         shape = "diamond",   # 菱形 = motif
                         color = "gold")
geneNodes  <- data.frame(id    = unique(edges$to),
                         label = unique(edges$to),
                         shape = "dot")       # 圆点 = gene
nodes <- rbind(motifNodes, geneNodes)

visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visIgraphLayout() %>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE)

#=======================================================================================
#                              pySCENIC的差异分析及其他思路
#=======================================================================================
#加载R包
library(limma)
library(SCENIC)
library(AUCell)
library(data.table)


anaAUC <- regulonAUC
anaAUC <- anaAUC[onlyNonDuplicatedExtended(rownames(anaAUC)),]
ana.cellinfo<-human_data@meta.data#细胞信息

#选取需要分析的细胞，这里我们以T cell为例子
Tcell.cellinfo <- subset(ana.cellinfo, ana.cellinfo$celltype=='T cell')
targets<-data.table(FileName=rownames(Tcell.cellinfo),Target=Tcell.cellinfo$group)#提取组合分组

#接下来其实就是常规的差异分析了
lev<-unique(targets$Target)
f <- factor(targets$Target, levels=lev) 
design <- model.matrix(~0+f) #样本矩阵
colnames(design) <- lev #design矩阵重命名

eset=getAUC(anaAUC) #获取所有细胞TF的AUC值
eset=eset[,targets$FileName]#我们只选取要分析的T细胞
eset<-t(scale(t(eset))) #scale

#比较分析limma
cont.wt <- makeContrasts("GM-BM",levels=design) #GM vs BM
fit <- lmFit(eset, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.wt) 
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2) 
tT=topTable(fit2, adjust="BH",sort.by="logFC",n=Inf)#差异分析结果

tT = subset(tT, select=c("adj.P.Val","P.Value","logFC"))
colnames(tT)=c("FDR","P.Value","logFC")#选择关键的三列即可
write.table(tT,file="Tcell_TF_GM_BM.csv",sep="\t",quote=F)#保存结果

#接下来就可以按照不同的阈值筛选显著的TF了，其实这样的差异分析对于结果的解释和
#应用上更有说服力，这样我们可以直观的看到某些转录因子在不同细胞状态下的差异
#可视化的话可以用热图、火山图等展示。

logFoldChange<-0.5
adjustP<-0.05
diffSig <- tT[with(tT, (abs(logFC)>logFoldChange & FDR < adjustP )), ]#显著筛选
diffSig=na.omit(diffSig)
rownames(diffSig)<-gsub("\\(","",rownames(diffSig))
rownames(diffSig)<-gsub("\\)","",rownames(diffSig))
rownames(diffSig)<-gsub("\\+","",rownames(diffSig))
write.csv(diffSig, file = "diffSig_TF.csv")



#我们用热图展示以下差异结果
#先计算每个样本细胞的平均表达值
regulonActivity_byCellType <- sapply(split(rownames(Tcell.cellinfo), Tcell.cellinfo$orig.ident),
                                     function(cells) rowMeans(getAUC(anaAUC)[,cells]))
regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled <- regulonActivity_byCellType
#这里有一个基础知识，很多文章展示TF不显示+号，用gsub函数就可以去除
rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled)<-gsub("\\(","",rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled))
rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled)<-gsub("\\)","",rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled))
rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled)<-gsub("\\+","",rownames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled))

#选择差异显著的TF进行可视化
selTF <- c("YY1","JUND","BCLAF1","SAP30","NR3C1","TAF7","ZNF148",
           "UBTF","FOS","ELF1","MXI1", "ZFX","ZMIZ1","TWIST1",
           "CEBPD","HOXD9","ETV4","TFDP1","BRF1","ZNF423","ZNF420",
           "HDAC2","GLIS1")

sel_regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled <- regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled[selTF,]

annotation_col = data.frame(group = c("BM","BM","BM","BM", "GM", "GM"))
rownames(annotation_col)<-colnames(regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled)
ann_colors =  list(group = c("BM" = "#619cff", "GM" = "#f8766d"))

pheatmap::pheatmap(sel_regulonActivity_byCellType_Scaled,
                   color=colorRampPalette(c("#00a9ff","white","#F8766D"))(100),
                   breaks=seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100),
                   border_color=NA,
                   cluster_rows = F,
                   cluster_cols=F,
                   annotation_col = annotation_col,
                   annotation_colors = ann_colors,
                   scale="row",
                   main = "T cell TF")

#=======================================================================================

#TF与靶基因的关系在pyscenic分析得到的第二个文件

sce_regulons <- read.csv("sce.regulons.csv")
sce_regulons <- sce_regulons[-2, ]
colnames(sce_regulons) <- sce_regulons[1,]

#举例子我这里关注FOXP3和TGIF1这两个TF

FOXP3 <- subset(sce_regulons, TF=='FOXP3')
FOXP3 <- FOXP3[which(FOXP3$AUC>0.1),]
FOXP3 <- FOXP3[, c("TF","TargetGenes")]
FOXP3$TargetGenes <-gsub("\\[","",FOXP3$TargetGenes)
FOXP3$TargetGenes <-gsub("\\]","",FOXP3$TargetGenes)
FOXP3$TargetGenes <-gsub("\\(","",FOXP3$TargetGenes)

library(stringr)
split_FOXP3<-str_split(FOXP3$TargetGenes,",")
FOXP31 <- as.data.frame(split_FOXP3[[1]])
FOXP32<- as.data.frame(split_FOXP3[[2]])

names(FOXP31) <- 'TF'

names(FOXP33) <- 'TF'
names(FOXP34) <- 'TF'
names(FOXP35) <- 'TF'

FOXP3 <- rbind(FOXP31,FOXP32,FOXP33,FOXP34,FOXP35)

FOXP3_target <- FOXP3[seq(1,nrow(FOXP3),2), ]

FOXP3_gene <- data.frame(FOXP3_target,FOXP3_score)
FOXP3_gene <- FOXP3_gene[!duplicated(FOXP3_gene$FOXP3_target), ]
FOXP3_gene$gene <- 'FOXP3'
colnames(FOXP3_gene) <- c("target","score",'tf')

#同理得到TGIF1及其靶基因，此处省略1万字
#two thousand years later
#TGIF1_gene

TF_target <- rbind(FOXP3_gene,TGIF1_gene)
TF_target$score <- as.numeric(TF_target$score)
###接下来就是网络图了

#节点数据
paths <- c("FOXP3", "TGIF1")#列重命名
nodelist <- list()
for (i in 1:length(paths)){
  node <- subset(TF_target, tf == paths[i])#提取数据
  
  nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(union(node$tf, node$target)))#整理为datafram
  nodes$value <- c(sum(node$score)/10, node$score)#加上values
  
  nodelist[[i]] <- nodes
}  #提取每个大节点数据


nodes <- rbind(nodelist[[1]],nodelist[[2]])#将三个节点文件合并
nodes$cluster <- c(rep("FOXP3",1),rep("FOXP3_gene",20),
                   rep("TGIF1",1),rep("TGIF1_gene",6))#分组，为了后续颜色设置

edges <- TF_target[c("tf","target","score")]#边缘文件
edges$class <- edges$tf

library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
layout_cir <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges)#构建ggraph作图文件
#作图
ggraph(layout_cir,layout='linear',circular = TRUE) +#选择circle
  geom_node_point(aes(size=value,colour = cluster))+#节点，大小用我们赋的值表示，颜色用分组
  geom_node_text(aes(x = 1.03 * x,
                     y = 1.03 * y,
                     label=name,
                     color=cluster,
                     angle = -((-node_angle(x, y) + 90) %% 180) + 90),
                 hjust='outward') +#文字设置。x，y是为了调整位置。angle是为了调整角度，以后其他所有网络图angle都用此公式，文字会向外发散排列
  geom_edge_arc(aes(colour=class))+#连线为曲线
  theme_void()+#theme主题
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  scale_colour_manual(values =c('#407972',
                                '#961E28',
                                '#D46724',
                                '#0f8096'))+#节点颜色
  scale_edge_colour_manual(values = c('#961E28',
                                      '#D46724',
                                      '#0f8096'))+#连线颜色
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,8))+#点的大小范围设置
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5,1.5),ylim = c(-1.5,1.5))#设置坐标位置，防止图溢出作图边界显示不全

"""Convert a Seurat-exported expression CSV to a pySCENIC loom file.

The CSV must have genes in rows and cells in columns, matching the export
from the R workflow in ``01_pySCENIC_R分析与可视化.R``.
"""

import argparse

import loompy as lp
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--input", default="sce_exp.csv", help="expression CSV")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="sce.loom", help="output loom")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    expression = sc.read_csv(args.input)
    row_attrs = {"Gene": np.asarray(expression.var_names)}
    col_attrs = {"CellID": np.asarray(expression.obs_names)}
    lp.create(args.output, expression.X.transpose(), row_attrs, col_attrs)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Required inputs. Set these before running, for example:
# TF_LIST=hs_hgnc_tfs.txt \
# MOTIF_ANNOTATIONS=motifs-v9-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl \
# RANKINGS_DB=hg38__refseq-r80__10kb_up_and_down_tss.mc9nr.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather \
# ./03_pySCENIC命令.sh

INPUT_LOOM="${INPUT_LOOM:-sce.loom}"
ADJACENCIES="${ADJACENCIES:-sce.adj.csv}"
REGULONS="${REGULONS:-sce.regulons.csv}"
OUTPUT_LOOM="${OUTPUT_LOOM:-sce_SCENIC.loom}"
THREADS="${THREADS:-10}"
AUCell_THREADS="${AUCell_THREADS:-3}"

: "${TF_LIST:?Set TF_LIST to the species-appropriate TF list}"
: "${MOTIF_ANNOTATIONS:?Set MOTIF_ANNOTATIONS to the motif annotation table}"
: "${RANKINGS_DB:?Set RANKINGS_DB to the cisTarget rankings database}"

pyscenic grn \
  --num_workers "$THREADS" \
  --sparse \
  --method grnboost2 \
  --output "$ADJACENCIES" \
  "$INPUT_LOOM" \
  "$TF_LIST"

pyscenic ctx \
  --num_workers "$THREADS" \
  --output "$REGULONS" \
  --expression_mtx_fname "$INPUT_LOOM" \
  --all_modules \
  --mask_dropouts \
  --mode dask_multiprocessing \
  --min_genes 10 \
  --annotations_fname "$MOTIF_ANNOTATIONS" \
  "$ADJACENCIES" \
  "$RANKINGS_DB"

pyscenic aucell \
  --num_workers "$AUCell_THREADS" \
  --output "$OUTPUT_LOOM" \
  "$INPUT_LOOM" \
  "$REGULONS"
